The '''air mines''' were a series of [[air spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] at the north pole of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]]. One variation of the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] mined here was known as [[swing dust]]. A local Kalimahr [[Unidentified wine (Kalimahr)|wine]] was fortified with the swing dust air spice from some of these mines.<ref name="Into the Void" />

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The air mines were first mentioned in ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'', a [[2013]] novel written by [[Tim Lebbon]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
